# Digital Hujra

Digital Hujra is a digital studio based in Batkhela, Malakand, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. We help local KP businesses establish and grow their digital presence.

## What We Do

We offer four core services:

- **POS Systems** — Inventory management, sales tracking, and barcode printing for retail and pharmacy businesses.
- **E-commerce Stores** — Complete online stores with product listings, Cash on Delivery, and WhatsApp checkout, tailored for KP markets.
- **Custom Software** — Bespoke web applications, CRMs, and automation tools built for local business workflows.
- **Product Photography** — Professional product photography and videography from our studio in Batkhela.

## Packages & Pricing

All packages are fixed-price in PKR with no hidden fees. Payment is split: 50% upfront, 50% after 3 months when the client is fully satisfied. Monthly support fees cover WhatsApp assistance, updates, and remote monitoring. Full pricing is available at https://www.digitalhujra.com/packages.

## Case Studies

- **Classyfitters** (Batkhela) — E-commerce store, product photography, WhatsApp Business, Google Business Profile.
- **Al Ansar Abaya** (Chakdara) — Full digital presence: e-commerce, product shoot, WhatsApp verified badge, Google Business.
- **Raazina Essence** (Swat) — 50+ professional perfume product images across two studio sessions.
- **Bayan Cafe** — Complete visual identity: logo, color system, typography, brand guidelines, and print collateral.

## About

Founded in 2026 by a team of designers, developers, and photographers from Malakand Division. Digital Hujra focuses exclusively on small and medium businesses in KP who want to reach customers online for the first time.
